title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $400 on roborock Qrevo S5V
excerpt: It can cope with all kinds of dirt, including pet hair.
content_html:
SAVE $400: As of Sept. 15, the Roborock Qrevo S5V is on sale for $499.98 at Amazon. That's a 44% discount on the list price.

Credit: roborock

$499.98 at Amazon

Robot vacuum deals are always something to get excited about, especially when they take hundreds of dollars off the list price, like this latest Amazon deal on the Roborock Qrevo S5V.

Normally $899.99, this model is currently on sale for $499.98, taking $400 off the list price. Not only that, but this is the lowest-ever price for this robot vacuum, so you know you've landed a great deal.

This robot vacuum has 12,000Pa of suction power to lift dirt and stubborn debris from carpets, rugs, and hard floors. It has a Zero-Tangle system that prevents hair from wrapping around the brushes, making it a great option for homes with pets.

And it doesn't just pick up dirt. This model also has a built-in mop with dual spinning mops that rotate at 200 RPM, so even the toughest floor stains are no problem to clean. After vacuuming and mopping, the all-in-one dock automatically empties the dustbin into a 10-week storage bin, washes the mops, dries them with warm air, and refills the water tank, so it's ready to go for its next clean with no assistance required.
